articles.description: The gang allegedly handed over account kits with passbooks, ATM cards, linked SIM cards and other documents to two people

articles.headline: European youth launch widespread protests amid economic and educational concerns
articles.title: Europe's youth is on the march - but does anything actually unite them?
articles.summary: Young people across several European countries have taken to the streets in recent weeks, staging demonstrations fueled by education grievances, social inequalities, and the rising cost of living. Organized largely through social media platforms like TikTok, the protests have affected nations including France, Spain, Portugal, and Italy, with participants expressing deep anxiety over future career stagnation and housing affordability.
articles.description: The last month has seen youth-driven demonstrations across Europe. What connects them?

articles.headline: M.K. Stalin condemns brief detention of Madras Institute of Development Studies professor
articles.title: Stalin demands apology from T.N. CM Vijay for MIDS professor’s detention; TVK denies ‘political vendetta’ claim
articles.summary: Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam president M.K. Stalin criticized the brief detention of associate professor Kalaiyarasan by plain-clothes police officers. Describing the action as politically motivated, Stalin demanded an apology from Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay and law enforcement for targeting the academic after he highlighted rising prices.
articles.description: The ruling TVK said the inquiry was not related to the professor’s remarks on rising rice prices

articles.headline: Deadly train crash alters political landscape ahead of Spanish election
articles.title: Spain’s deadly train crash redraws electoral battle lines
articles.summary: A high-speed train collision near Toledo killed 69 people, abruptly shifting Spain's electoral focus from housing to infrastructure safety and government competence ahead of the November 29 election. Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez faces intense scrutiny and suspended campaigning from rivals, while officials investigate a potential failure involving the legacy LZB train-control system.
articles.description: The tragedy has upended the November 29 election campaign, shifting attention from housing to security.

articles.headline: China rejects espionage allegations targeting Nvidia chief executive
articles.title: China denies allegations of spy operation targeting Nvidia CEO
articles.summary: Beijing dismissed allegations of a Chinese intelligence operation targeting Nvidia Chief Executive Jensen Huang as groundless speculation, according to a foreign ministry spokesman. United States intelligence officials previously investigated businesswoman Alice Huang over suspected information gathering and chip diversions involving Singapore-based Megaspeed. Nvidia maintained that its interactions with Alice Huang were routine business engagements involving no sensitive trade secrets.
articles.description: US intelligence officials believe a Chinese businesswoman was gathering information for Beijing on the US chip-making giant, The New York Times reports.

articles.headline: Saudi Aramco and Sonatrach raise November liquefied petroleum gas prices
articles.title: Saudi Aramco, Sonatrach raise LPG official selling prices for November, say sources
articles.summary: Saudi Aramco increased its official selling prices for liquefied petroleum gas by up to 6.8 percent for November, driven by seasonal demand and limited global supply. Algerian state producer Sonatrach also raised its November prices significantly. These adjustments serve as vital pricing benchmarks for energy markets across the Asia-Pacific, Mediterranean and Black Sea regions.
articles.description: Saudi Aramco's OSPs are used ​as a reference ‌for contracts to supply LPG from the West Asia to the Asia-Pacific region

articles.headline: Capgemini operations business outpaces core technology services for third straight quarter
articles.title: Capgemini’s operations business outpaces core IT for third straight quarter
articles.summary: Capgemini reported that its Operations and Engineering business expanded 26.9% year-on-year in the September quarter, outpacing core technology services for the third consecutive period. Supported by the integration of WNS and Cloud4C, total revenue reached 6.07 billion euros while bookings rose to 5.40 billion euros, according to the French multinational information technology services company.
articles.description: Operations & Engineering grew 26.9% in the September quarter, against 3.5% growth in Applications & Technology; acquisitions and demand for AI-led business transformation support performance

articles.headline: Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister criticises Congress leader Rahul Gandhi over anarchy
articles.title: ‘Ignorant’ Rahul spreading anarchy, seems like he has come from Pakistan to do politics here: MP CM
articles.summary: Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Mohan Yadav criticised Congress leader Rahul Gandhi during a political rally on October 30, 2026, accusing him of spreading anarchy and questioning vital democratic institutions. Speaking at a Bharatiya Janata Party event, the chief minister alleged that the opposition leader's actions undermine the nation's progress under Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
articles.description: Yadav was speaking at a rally in connection with the Bharatiya Janata Party's 'Loktantra Bachao, Arrajakta Hatao' (save democracy, end anarchy) march

articles.headline: Georgia emerges as crucial battleground ahead of upcoming United States midterm elections
articles.title: Georgia midterm elections: Why this is a key US battleground
articles.summary: Georgia has become a key swing state in the United States midterm elections, with both major political parties committing substantial resources to the southern region. Democratic incumbent Senator Jon Ossoff faces Republican challenger Mike Collins, while former Atlanta mayor Keisha Lance Bottoms competes against billionaire Rick Jackson in a tightly contested gubernatorial race.
articles.description: Obama and Trump campaign in key battleground state ahead of next week's midterm elections.

articles.headline: Election Commission revision leaves over six lakh voters out in Belagavi district
articles.title: Over 6.5 lakh voters left out in Belagavi, the biggest electoral district in Karnataka
articles.summary: The Election Commission of India removed 658,862 voters from electoral rolls in Belagavi district following a special intensive revision, reducing the total count to 3,494,913 individuals. The deletions include approximately 103,839 Muslim voters across eighteen assembly constituencies, triggering complaints from various political figures regarding alleged rule violations and third-party objections.
articles.description: They include 1.03 lakh Muslims

articles.headline: Tamil Nadu increases upper age limit for government service recruitment
articles.title: Tamil Nadu raises upper age limit for direct recruitment into government services by five years
articles.summary: The Tamil Nadu government enhanced the upper age limit for direct recruitment to various government services by five years following orders issued by Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay. Introduced in response to candidate demands, the policy took effect on October 30, 2026, and will remain in force for five years, benefiting thousands approaching existing age limits for competitive examinations across multiple categories.
articles.description: It will be in addition to the existing age concessions available to candidates belonging to the BC, BC (Muslims), MBC/DNC, SC, ST, and destitute widows, the release said

articles.headline: Himalayan building boom puts hundreds of thousands at disaster risk
articles.title: Building boom puts 300,000 people in the path of potential Himalayan disasters
articles.summary: A peer-reviewed study published in Scientific Reports indicates that at least 300,000 individuals in the Himalayan region now reside in high-risk hazard zones. Researchers discovered that built-up land across northern Nepal, south-eastern Tibet, and India's Uttarakhand expanded by approximately 45 percent between 2016 and 2023. Scientists attribute the escalating threat of floods and landslides primarily to rapid regional temperature warming that accelerates glacial melting.
articles.description: The construction of tourism facilities, housing, and infrastructure has surged in parts of Nepal and India's Uttarakhand.

articles.headline: Activists urge Eisenkot to form new Israeli gov’t with Arab parties
articles.title: Activists urge Eisenkot to form new Israeli gov’t with Arab parties
articles.description: Israeli activists rally outside opposition leader Eisenkot’s home, urging him to join forces with Arab parties after ele

articles.headline: Israel faces political deadlock after general election
articles.title: How can Israel break its election deadlock?
articles.summary: Following the October 27, 2026 vote, Israel faces a political deadlock as neither Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc nor the opposition grouping led by Gadi Eisenkot secured the sixty-one seats needed to form a government in the one hundred and twenty-member Knesset. The Central Elections Committee published the final results on Friday, leaving coalition consultations underway and raising the possibility of a rerun election.
articles.description: No political party has achieved the 61-seat majority required in the Knesset to form a government in Israel.

articles.headline: Keralam Excise Minister mandates Aadhaar age verification for bars
articles.title: Bars must verify customers’ age through Aadhaar, warns Keralam Excise Minister
articles.summary: Keralam Excise Minister M. Liju directed all bars across the state to verify customers' ages using Aadhaar cards before serving alcohol. Speaking on Friday, October 30, 2026, the minister warned that establishments violating the 23 legal drinking age would face immediate licence suspension. The directive follows a fatal drunk-driving road accident in Nedumbassery that claimed three lives.
articles.description: Minister M. Liju warns suspension of licences for serving liquor to underage customers; directive comes in the wake of a drunk-driving road accident at Nedumbassery that claimed three lives

articles.headline: Maharashtra legislative council election results deliver setback for ruling alliance
articles.title: Maharashtra MLC polls: Lessons for the BJP, hope for Maha Vikas Aghadi | Explained
articles.summary: Maharashtra legislative council election results proved to be a setback for the ruling Mahayuti coalition, leading to open rifts among alliance partners due to dissatisfaction over seat distribution. The opposition Maha Vikas Aghadi alliance won three of the five seats, with Sharad Pawar's Nationalist Congress Party Socialist Project securing two seats and the Congress winning one, according to an article published on October 30, 2026.
articles.description: Congress hits the BJP where it hurts the most. Its only victory is in the RSS HQ and BJP’s traditional stronghold of Nagpur, Sharad Pawar’s party shines with a 100% strike rate; MVA wins all three Graduates’ constituencies; Mahayuti wins both Teachers’ constituencies

articles.headline: US border immigration policies galvanise voters in Texas
articles.title: On the US border in Texas, Trump deportation drive galvanises midterm vote
articles.summary: Residents in the Rio Grande Valley of Texas are confronting sweeping deportation policies and ICE detentions ahead of the November 3 midterm elections. Community organisers and local voters report deep divisions over the economic and social impacts of enforcement under US President Donald Trump. Studies estimate the region has lost 180.6 million dollars in economic activity due to these federal measures.
articles.description: Border issues helped propel Trump in the Rio Grande Valley in 2024. His deportation policies could bury Republicans.

articles.headline: BJP questions Rahul Gandhi over past remarks and election commission appointments
articles.title: BJP targets Rahul Gandhi over past remarks on Hindutva, questions Congress on ECI appointment process
articles.summary: Bharatiya Janata Party released a video criticizing Congress leader Rahul Gandhi for his previous statements on Hinduism while simultaneously questioning opposition criticism regarding the historical appointment process of chief election commissioners. The political sparring unfolded against an ongoing electoral roll revision controversy and opposition demands for the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities.
articles.description: The BJP questioned the Congress over its criticism of the process of appointment of chief election commissioners, claiming that during the Congress rule, there was neither a law nor a committee for selecting election commissioners

articles.headline: Dockworkers across twenty two countries launch global strike over Gaza conflict
articles.title: What can a global strike of dockworkers achieve for Gaza?
articles.summary: Port workers and maritime trade unions spanning twenty two countries initiated a coordinated global strike to protest against the ongoing military onslaught in Gaza and weapon shipments to Israel. Organizers reported that over one hundred ten ports participated in the historic day of action, demanding an immediate end to the conflict and highlighting the critical role of maritime infrastructure in military supply chains.
articles.description: More than 25 dockworkers' trade unions in 110 ports of 22 countries are going on strike on October 30.

articles.headline: Confederation of African Football reverses decision to restore biennial tournament cycle
articles.title: AFCON returns to 2-year cycle after CAF reverses quadrennial decision
articles.summary: The Confederation of African Football announced that the Africa Cup of Nations will return to a two-year cycle after unanimously reversing an earlier decision to transition to a four-year schedule. Officials stated the reinstatement aims to protect the interests of African football and players, with upcoming tournaments scheduled across Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda and subsequent host nations.
articles.description: Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda will cohost the next AFCON in 2027, with subsequent tournaments in 2028, 2031 and 2033.

articles.headline: Bhutan glacial lake outburst triggers flash floods
articles.title: Bhutan glacial lake outburst triggers flash floods
articles.description: A glacial lake outburst in northern Bhutan has triggered flash flooding.

articles.headline: Telangana government protects public land worth nearly one point five lakh crore
articles.title: Telangana CM Revanth says Govt protected ₹1.5 lakh crore worth public lands since December 2023
articles.summary: Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy announced that his administration successfully protected public lands and assets valued at approximately one point five lakh crore rupees through legal battles since December 2023. Speaking in New Delhi, Reddy alleged that former Chief Minister K. Chandrashekar Rao and other leaders attempted to appropriate valuable state properties, including disputed land parcels in Miyapur.
articles.description: Chief Minister alleges KCR, family members tried to grab valuable Miyapur lands that are protected by Supreme Court now; lists lands across Telangana protected by the State government from alleged encroachment by BRS leaders

articles.headline: Prime Minister Narendra Modi vows to serve Indian citizens until his final breath
articles.title: I will serve the people of India till my last breath: PM Modi
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi declared he would dedicate his life to serving Indian citizens during an address in Banaskantha district, following recent controversial remarks by opposition figures. Modi inaugurated the Bharat Bovine Breeding and Research Centre and launched development projects worth fourteen thousand crore rupees, while accusing political opponents of spreading rumors regarding fertilizer and LPG supplies during global uncertainties.
articles.description: Addressing a gathering in Gujarat’s Banaskantha district, PM Modi responded to Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge’s remark and said some people spread rumours after the Iran war

articles.headline: Minority leaders in Bengaluru urge Karnataka government to repeal anti-conversion law
articles.title: Religious minority leaders urge Karnataka government to repeal anti-conversion law, strengthen legislation to address hate speech
articles.summary: Representatives of religious minorities and civil society organisations urged the Karnataka government on October 30, 2026, to repeal the Protection of Right to Freedom of Religion Act, 2022. According to Peter Machado, Archbishop of Bengaluru, and Mohammed Yahya Damudi, the legislation criminalises minority existence. Leaders also demanded stronger hate speech laws and the revocation of cattle slaughter and land reform acts.
articles.description: The minority leaders argued that religious freedom cannot meaningfully exist where individuals and communities must constantly defend the legitimacy of their faith and religious practices against suspicion of criminal wrongdoing.

articles.headline: Survivors recount horror following deadly high-speed train collision in Spain
articles.title: Bloodied, dazed and angry - how passengers' rail journey turned to disaster in Spain
articles.summary: Passengers aboard two southward-bound trains traveling from Madrid to Seville experienced severe trauma when a state-operated Renfe train collided with a stationary Iryo private train on Wednesday. Survivors described being thrown into the air, falling among debris, and witnessing fatalities and severe injuries. Spain's Transport Minister Óscar Puente stated that the Renfe train was erroneously ordered to proceed following an automatic signalling system failure.
articles.description: Survivors of the train crash in Spain have spoken of their shock, panic and anger at the accident in Toledo province on Wednesday.

articles.headline: Indian researchers identify new protein within plant defence mechanisms against pests
articles.title: Indian scientists find new gateway in plants’ alarm system
articles.summary: Scientists at the National Institute of Plant Genome Research have discovered an uncharacterised protein that enables plants to alert undamaged foliage when herbivores attack another part of the organism. This finding highlights complex biological defence systems and could assist in developing new agricultural crop chemicals. The discovery was officially detailed by the research facility on October thirty, two thousand twenty-six, shedding further light on plant survival strategies against predators.
articles.description: Insect pests cause roughly 20% of global annual crop losses, a figure projected to rise with warming, and crop protection still leans heavily on chemical insecticides. Learning how plants sense attack could point to crops that defend themselves better

articles.headline: Jamia Millia Islamia establishes panel to draft student union constitution
articles.title: Jamia student protest: Why is the Lyngdoh Committee report significant? | Explained
articles.summary: Jamia Millia Islamia in New Delhi formed a five-member committee chaired by Dean Zubair Meenai to draft a new students union constitution. The union has remained dissolved since 2006. Announced on October 29, 2026, the initiative follows ongoing student protests that began on October 12 to demand restored representation, with the panel reviewing past court rulings and the 2006 Lyngdoh Committee recommendations.
articles.description: The Committee, headed by former CEC J.M. Lyngdoh, issued the report dated May 23, 2006; it felt that party-linked student organisations politicise campus elections and split students into rival factions

articles.headline: Cyclone Arnab disrupts rail services forcing train cancellations and diversions
articles.title: Cyclone Arnab: Bhubaneswar-Visakhapatnam Vande Bharat among 35 trains cancelled
articles.summary: Cyclone Arnab has severely disrupted railway networks along the Indian coastline, prompting South Central Railway to cancel thirty-five trains, including the Bhubaneswar-Visakhapatnam Vande Bharat Express on October 29, 2026. Heavy rainfall and rising water levels between Ichchapuram and Jhadupudi forced authorities to halt operations, reschedule dozens of departures, and divert long-distance services while track safety assessments and restoration efforts proceed on an emergency basis.
articles.description: Water over railway bridges between Ichchapuram and Jhadupudi halts services on the Chennai-Howrah main line

articles.headline: Israel faces political deadlock and deep societal divisions following election
articles.title: Israel's election deadlock is a sign of the country's deep divisions
articles.summary: Israel faces an inconclusive election result leaving neither political bloc with a parliamentary majority after record voter turnout. President Isaac Herzog warned against government instability amid deep societal tensions between religious and secular populations, ultra-Orthodox military exemptions, and opposing views on leadership under Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
articles.description: The election was a celebration of democracy in some ways - but it has left Israel with no clear path to a new government, writes James Landale.

articles.headline: Nirmala Sitharaman defends IDBI Bank divestment amid political row with Congress
articles.title: IDBI Bank divestment: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman says Congress, UPA govt used banks, financial institutions as personal entities
articles.summary: Indian Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman defended the divestment of IDBI Bank on October 30, 2026, accusing the former Congress-led UPA government of misusing financial institutions for politically motivated loans. Her remarks follow the central government's approval to sell a 60.72 percent stake in IDBI Bank to Canada's Fairfax Financial Holdings for approximately fifty-three thousand crore rupees, drawing sharp criticism from opposition leader Rahul Gandhi over the privatization of a profitable public asset.
articles.description: Responding to Rahul Gandhi’s criticism of the IDBI Bank sale to Fairfax, Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman alleges the Congress-led governments pressured bank employees to lend at their whim

articles.headline: Indian Embassy opens helpline following deadly Spanish train collision
articles.title: Spain train crash: Indian Embassy in Madrid issues helpline after deadly accident
articles.summary: The Indian Embassy in Madrid established an emergency helpline after a high-speed train collision south of Madrid killed at least 68 people on October 28, 2026. The tragedy occurred when a Renfe state train collided with a stationary Iryo service, prompting a high-level government investigation into potential safety and control centre failures.
articles.description: After the Spain train crash, the Indian Embassy in Madrid issued the emergency helpline number +34 650 339 008, the email cons.madrid@mea.gov.in, and Renfe: 900 10 10 20, and Iryo: 900 001 403

articles.headline: Enforcement Directorate conducts raids in West Bengal over insolvency proceedings
articles.title: Misuse of insolvency proceedings: ED conducts raids in West Bengal
articles.summary: The Enforcement Directorate conducted searches across eight premises in West Bengal on Friday as part of a money laundering probe. The investigation focuses on the alleged misuse of National Company Law Tribunal proceedings and the suspected utilisation of proceeds of crime involving Kohinoor Power and lender banks. The action was initiated under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act and targeted company directors, auditors, and resolution professionals.
articles.description: A total of eight premises have been raided in the State in the case involving Kohinoor Power, lender banks and some others, says officials

articles.headline: Ladakh administration suspends liquor policy protest following agreement with activists
articles.title: Protest against liquor policy suspended after Ladakh admin agrees to all demands: Sonam Wangchuk
articles.summary: Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk announced that demonstrations against Ladakh's new liquor policy were temporarily suspended after the Union Territory administration agreed to all demands. The Home Department issued a written assurance on October 29, 2026, accepting recommendations from four women's organisations. Officials requested a week to formalise the agreement, leading protesters to halt their planned dharna while aiming to safeguard cultural values.
articles.description: Women-led protests began last week in Ladakh, driven by a newly introduced liquor policy, demanding a complete rollback of the policy and for Ladakh to be declared a dry Union territory

articles.headline: Kenyan national indicted in Nebraska over alleged US federal student aid fraud
articles.title: How Kenyans got caught in $130m US ghost student scam
articles.summary: A grand jury in Nebraska indicted Francis Mogambi on counts of theft and identity theft, alleging he stole US citizens' identities to enroll fake students in colleges and divert federal financial aid. Prosecutors stated the scheme involved international money transfers to Kenya. The case is part of Operation Ghostbusters, a broader US investigation targeting potential fraud involving hundreds of thousands of student identification numbers.
articles.description: The alleged scheme used stolen identities to claim US student aid, with Kenyans among those charged.

articles.headline: INDIA bloc plans public impeachment of Chief Election Commissioner
articles.title: INDIA bloc’s ‘public impeachment’ of CEC likely to avoid mocking Parliament
articles.summary: The Indian National Developmental Inclusive Alliance coalition is organizing a public impeachment event targeting Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged electoral manipulation. Scheduled for Friday at the residence of Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge in New Delhi, the proceedings will feature opposition leaders including Rahul Gandhi. Organizers stated the program will avoid imagery mocking parliamentary institutions ahead of a planned protest march at Ramlila Maidan on Sunday, November 1, 2026.
articles.description: Former Lok Sabha Speaker Meira Kumar to preside over proceedings, Kharge to move motion and Rahul Gandhi to speak at the end

articles.headline: United Nations General Assembly votes to condemn United States embargo of Cuba
articles.title: UN votes to condemn embargo of Cuba despite US lobbying push
articles.summary: The United Nations General Assembly voted 130 to 17 on Wednesday to condemn the United States economic embargo against Cuba, despite American diplomatic pressure that increased abstentions. Cuban Foreign Minister Bruno Rodriguez criticized the decades-long restrictions, while US Ambassador to the United Nations Mike Waltz announced the expulsion of a Cuban diplomat following an altercation.
articles.description: US points to increase in abstentions in General Assembly as evidence that push to isolate Cuba is slowly succeeding.

articles.headline: Wildfire smoke kills over 3500 people in Indonesia during September
articles.title: Smoke from wildfires killed 3,500 people in Indonesia in September: Report
articles.summary: Toxic smoke from Indonesian wildfires caused 3560 deaths in September, according to a report released on Thursday by the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air. The Helsinki-based think tank reported that air pollution deaths surged by 42 percent during the month amid severe drought and El Nino weather patterns, exposing a record 58 million citizens to hazardous air quality across the region.
articles.description: Persistent wildfires sparked by drought have enveloped the region in smog.

articles.headline: Nairobi to host 2029 World Athletics Championships as Kenya wins bid
articles.title: Kenya’s 2029 World Athletics bid: A win for Africa under scrutiny
articles.summary: Nairobi was selected to host the 2029 World Athletics Championships during a meeting in Budapest on September 15, making it the first African city to stage the competition. While local officials and figures like Kipchoge Keino celebrated the milestone, the decision faced scrutiny regarding Kenya's history of anti-doping violations and the country's ongoing sports infrastructure preparations.
articles.description: Kenya aims to turn its rich athletics heritage into a lasting legacy for the continent.

articles.headline: Cyclone Arnab brings severe floods and displaces thousands in Andhra Pradesh
articles.title: Cyclone Arnab: 10,000 in relief camps in flood-hit Ichchapuram in Andhra; NH-16 still under water
articles.summary: Flash floods from the Bahuda river following Cyclone Arnab forced about 10000 people into relief camps across Ichchapuram in Andhra Pradesh, while National Highway 16 remained submerged. Srikakulam Collector Swapnil Dinakar Pundkar monitored rescue operations as officials distributed food and addressed widespread power outages, crop damage, and infrastructure destruction caused by the heavy rains and gales.
articles.description: Crops on 21,519 hectares have been damaged in Srikakulam district, initial estimates show

articles.headline: Kerala High Court strikes down ban on women working in toddy shops
articles.title: Kerala HC strikes down Abkari rule provision prohibiting employment of women in toddy shops
articles.summary: The Kerala High Court invalidated a rule from the Kerala Abkari Shops Disposal Rules, 2002, which previously prohibited women from working in toddy shops. Justice P. Gopinath ruled that the restriction violated constitutional rights regarding equality and trade. The state government had argued the measure protected women from remote workplace exploitation. The October 30, 2026 verdict follows previous rulings striking down similar regulations in foreign liquor shops.
articles.description: Court holds that the provision violated constitutional rights to equality, to carry on any trade and the right against discrimination and right to life

articles.headline: Google releases new Gemini 4 Carbon model with advanced cybersecurity features
articles.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon with a ‘significant leap’ in cybersecurity
articles.summary: Google has announced the release of Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest frontier model featuring significant improvements in coding and cybersecurity. Available initially to select defense companies through the Fairwind Program at an introductory price of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, the model excels at discovering real-world bugs and generating secure code.
articles.description: Google has released its latest frontier model, Gemini 4 Carbon, offering "significant gains" in coding, agentic tasks, and cybersecurity. In an announcement on Wednesday, Google highlights Carbon's top spot on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (v5.0) benchmark, with Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra trailing behind. The new Gemini 4 Carbon model offers improvements over […]

articles.headline: Madras High Court bars police from permitting protests targeting judges
articles.title: Don’t grant permission for public gatherings targeting judges, Madras High Court directs Tamil Nadu police
articles.summary: The Madras High Court directed the Tamil Nadu police on October 30, 2026, to deny permits for public gatherings that personally target or intimidate sitting judges. Chief Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari and Justice G. Arul Murugan issued the order during a public interest litigation hearing regarding protests that followed a ruling by a Bench led by Justice G.R. Swaminathan concerning reservations for converted Muslims.
articles.description: Chief Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari and Justice G. Arul Murugan issue the direction pursuant to a PIL petition complaining about personal attacks made against Justice G.R. Swaminathan

articles.headline: Rahul Gandhi opposes government sale of IDBI Bank to Canadian firm
articles.title: Public banks not assets to be sold off, they are tools to build nation: Rahul amid IDBI bank sale row
articles.summary: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi criticized the federal government on October 30, 2026, over the planned sale of a 60.72 percent stake in Industrial Development Bank of India (IDBI) Bank to Canada-based Fairfax Financial Holdings for approximately 53,000 crore rupees. Gandhi stated that public banks serve as nation-building tools rather than commercial assets. The transaction awaits regulatory approval from the Reserve Bank of India before concluding.
articles.description: ‘I took that question to the Lok Sabha. I asked why a profitable public bank was being sold and how its employees and depositors would be protected. The government gave no reason. Now it has decided to sell IDBI Bank to Fairfax, a Canadian company,’ says Rahul Gandhi

articles.headline: Pakistani human rights lawyers sentenced to 10 years in prison over security breach
articles.title: Human rights lawyer couple sentenced to 10 years' prison in Pakistan
articles.summary: A Pakistani anti-terrorism court sentenced human rights lawyer Imaan Mazari and her husband Hadi Ali Chattha to 10 years in prison. Prosecutors stated the couple removed road barriers and obstructed police during an October 25, 2024, cricket tour in Islamabad. Both denied the charges. Amnesty International criticized the trial, while the defendants maintained they faced state persecution for their activism.
articles.description: Imaan Mazari and Hadi Ali Chattha were charged over an incident in 2024, when England's cricket team was touring Pakistan.

articles.headline: Philippines raises alert as Mayon Volcano erupts
articles.title: Philippines raises alert as Mayon Volcano erupts
articles.description: The Philippines’ Mayon Volcano has erupted, sending ash plumes 3,000 metres above its summit.

articles.headline: Bangladesh police recover body of former Air Force officer in Dhaka
articles.title: Bangladesh police recovers body of ex-Air Force officer from river in Dhaka
articles.summary: Bangladesh police recovered the body of former Air Force Flight Lieutenant K.M. Tahsif Souri from the Turag River in Dhaka on October 30, 2026, following his disappearance two days prior. Souri, previously dismissed from service in August 2024, had reportedly filmed a video of deposed Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina leaving the country, though Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed declined to comment on potential links pending preliminary investigations.
articles.description: Air Force Flight Lieutenant K.M. Tahsif Souri reportedly filmed a video showing deposed P.M. Sheikh Hasina leaving Bangladesh in an Air Force aircraft on August 5, 2024, according to local media

articles.headline: Cyber hygiene becomes essential defence against growing digital threats
articles.title: The digital pathogen: Why cyber hygiene is no longer optional | Explained
articles.summary: Poor cyber hygiene has emerged as a major digital pathogen across multiple sectors, including authenticating agencies, following serious security scares faced by financial institutions and public bodies. According to reports published on October 30, 2026, the concept has increasingly become a critical part of vocabulary as the first line of defence against escalating cybercrime in the modern digital age.
articles.description: The term cyber hygiene, the first line of defence against cybercrime, increasingly got into the vocabulary after financial institutions and public bodies suffered serious security scares

articles.headline: Cyclone Arnab impacts 17 Odisha districts as heavy rainfall triggers flood warnings
articles.title: Cyclone Arnab: 17 Odisha districts affected by heavy rain, Gajapati worst hit
articles.summary: Seventeen districts in Odisha have been affected by heavy rainfall brought by severe cyclonic storm Arnab, which crossed the Andhra Pradesh coast on October 28, 2026. Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi stated that authorities evacuated 43,827 people to 634 relief camps, while the Central Water Commission warned of potential flooding across multiple river basins due to ongoing extreme weather.
articles.description: As many as 2,245 pregnant women were shifted to nearby health centres, while 931 babies were born during the disaster

articles.headline: Vladimir Putin praises Elon Musk following satellite technology discussions
articles.title: Elon Musk is a 'real genius', Putin says after satellite talks with SpaceX boss
articles.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin described SpaceX founder Elon Musk as a real genius during the Russia-Africa Summit in Moscow, confirming close contact between the two regarding satellite technology. Putin emphasized the necessity of coordinating between Starlink and Russia's Rassvet internet project to prevent orbital interference, highlighting ongoing communication between American and Russian partners despite broader geopolitical tensions.
articles.description: The Russian President praised Musk and said they are in "close" contact.

articles.headline: High Arab voter turnout surges in Israeli legislative elections
articles.title: What has driven the high Arab turnout in Israel’s elections?
articles.summary: Israel recorded a 77.7% voter turnout in the October 27, 2026, legislative elections, driven significantly by a surge among Arab citizens. Exit polls estimated Arab participation at nearly 80%, largely motivated by fear of a right-wing government under Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. This high participation positions Arab parties to potentially secure at least 17 Knesset seats and influence coalition formation.
articles.description: Arab voter turnout is estimated to be nearly 80%, the highest in at least a decade, according to exit polls

articles.headline: Putin: Russia is African continent’s best partner, not ‘colonial’ West
articles.title: Putin: Russia is African continent’s best partner, not ‘colonial’ West
articles.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin told the leaders of dozens of African nations that Moscow was their best partner.

articles.headline: Israel faces political deadlock after general election yields no clear winner
articles.title: What are the implications of Israel’s elections?
articles.summary: Israel's first election since the October 7 attacks concluded with a record turnout but failed to produce a clear winner, leaving Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing alliance short of a majority. The main opposition bloc led by Gadi Eisenkot also lacks the numbers to govern alone, while Arab-led lists achieved unprecedented electoral gains during the closely watched contest.
articles.description: No clear winner in Israel's first election since the October 7 attacks and genocidal war in Gaza.

articles.headline: Russian President Vladimir Putin denies neo-colonial exploitation at Russia-Africa Summit
articles.title: Putin tells African leaders Moscow will not pursue ‘neo-colonialism’
articles.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin addressed delegates from 48 African countries at the third Russia-Africa Summit in Moscow on October 28, 2026, stating that Moscow avoids neo-colonial exploitation. Putin criticised Western nations for predatory financial practices and highlighted that Russia supplied 13 million metric tonnes of agricultural products to Africa in the first nine months of the year.
articles.description: Speaking at the third Russia-Africa Summit, Putin frames Moscow as an alternative to former colonial powers.

articles.headline: DMK president M.K. Stalin criticizes Tamil Nadu government over law and order
articles.title: Stalin slams Vijay govt. over law and order, rising prices; says DMK to hold protest on October 31
articles.summary: Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam president M.K. Stalin criticized Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay on Friday, accusing the government of incompetence and a deteriorating law and order situation in Tamil Nadu. Stalin announced that the DMK women's wing will organize statewide protests on Saturday against rising prices and a lack of safety. He highlighted multiple crimes and questioned the administration regarding drug trafficking allegations involving ruling party members.
articles.description: “Isn’t the Chief Minister directly responsible for the Police department? Shouldn’t he hold review meetings with Police officials and issue appropriate directions?” the DMK president asked

articles.headline: Delhi Police sets conditions for INDIA bloc protest rally
articles.title: INDIA bloc rally on November 1: What are the conditions imposed by Delhi Police
articles.summary: Authorities in Delhi permitted the opposition INDIA bloc to conduct a protest demonstration at Ramlila Maidan on November 1, 2026, aimed at demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The clearance issued by the police includes mandates on timing, security monitoring systems, parking arrangements, and restrictions against inflammatory public remarks.
articles.description: The INDIA block rally will be held at the Ramlila Maidan, which is one of the three designated protest sites in Delhi after Jantar Mantar was de-notified

articles.headline: Swedish academic Andreas Malm denied entry to the United Kingdom over Palestine event
articles.title: UK denies entry to Swedish academic due to speak at Palestine event
articles.summary: Swedish academic Andreas Malm was denied entry to the United Kingdom after the Home Office cancelled his Electronic Travel Authorisation on Wednesday. Malm believes the decision stems from his scheduled appearance at a London panel organised by Tribune alongside Palestine Action cofounder Huda Ammori. The UK government previously proscribed Palestine Action as a terrorist group under former Prime Minister Keir Starmer, a policy critics argue continues under the administration.
articles.description: Home Office cancels Andreas Malm's planned travel to the UK, saying his presence 'not conducive to the public good'.

articles.headline: Congress urges Centre to lead coordinated cyclone Arnab relief efforts
articles.title: Cyclone Arnab: Congress says Centre must lead coordinated relief efforts with State Govt., ensure assistance via PMCARES fund
articles.summary: Following the devastation caused by Cyclone Arnab, Congress leaders including president Mallikarjun Kharge and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra urged the Union Government on October 30, 2026, to lead coordinated relief operations with state authorities in Andhra Pradesh and Odisha. Party officials called for timely financial assistance via the PMCARES fund for all impacted families following severe flooding and loss of life.
articles.description: Rahul Gandhi urged the governments to ensure swift relief and rehabilitation for every affected family, while Mallikarjun Kharge urged party workers to extend all possible help to those in distress

articles.headline: Former flight attendant transitions to management role at Telangana coal mine
articles.title: Telangana spotlight: Women blast through the mining barriers
articles.summary: Tumram Priya transitioned from working as a flight attendant to managing personnel and vehicles at an office near an opencast coal mine in Telangana. The 27-year-old commerce graduate secured the job under a dependent quota at Singareni Collieries Company Limited after her father took voluntary retirement due to health issues, according to a report published on October 30, 2026.
articles.description: From handling explosives and repairing heavy mining equipment to supervising underground operations and training to drive 100-tonne dumpers, women at State-owned Singareni Collieries Company Limited are moving into jobs long considered a male preserve after amendments to the Mines Act helped open up these opportunities to them. However, challenges remain, including workplace safety, gender bias and physical demands of such roles, writes P. Laxma Reddy

articles.headline: UK Chancellor John Healey unveils Autumn Budget with new household support
articles.title: Five key takeaways from the UK Autumn Budget
articles.summary: Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey unveiled the United Kingdom government budget on Wednesday, offering twenty million households a one-off payment of one hundred pounds towards energy bills. The package includes increased defence spending, higher minimum wages, and temporary bank corporation tax surcharges. According to the Office for Budget Responsibility, real earnings will see no growth next year.
articles.description: The United Kingdom's government says its policies are for the 'working people of Britain'.

articles.headline: Survivors urge safety investments following deadly Spanish train crashes
articles.title: Survivors of Spain’s worst train crashes urge action after latest disaster
articles.summary: Survivors of Spain's worst rail disasters are demanding increased infrastructure maintenance following a collision on October 28, 2026, near Urda that killed at least 69 people, preceded by an Adamuz crash in January killing 46. Experts and union representatives noted that while high-speed rail usage reached roughly 40 million passengers in 2024, inadequate maintenance spending and obsolete control systems continue to endanger networks.
articles.description: As people suffering post-traumatic stress watch history repeat itself, experts call for investment in safety.

articles.headline: PM Modi begins two-day Gujarat visit to inaugurate development projects
articles.title: PM Modi begins two-day Gujarat visit; inaugurates ₹325-crore bovine breeding centre in Banaskantha
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi arrived in Gujarat on October 30, 2026, for a two-day tour to inaugurate ₹14,000 crore worth of development projects, release the 24th instalment of PM-KISAN payouts, and launch transport initiatives. He will also inaugurate Bharat Parv 2026 at Ekta Nagar and participate in Rashtriya Ekta Diwas celebrations honoring Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.
articles.description: The Prime Minister will also visit Ekta Nagar, where the tallest statue of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel stands, to inaugurate the cultural and tourism festival Bharat Parv 2026 and participate in Narmada aarti, said officials

articles.headline: Democrats lead national polls as Trump cancels upcoming weekend rallies
articles.title: US midterms: 4 days to go – What the polls say as Trump cancels two rallies
articles.summary: With the United States midterm elections approaching on November 3, 2026, Democrats held an 8.2 percentage point lead over Republicans according to RealClearPolling. Meanwhile, President Donald Trump cancelled weekend events in Kansas and Iowa to conduct telephone rallies across nearly 20 states, while a legal dispute in Alaska threatened potential delays for a critical Senate race result.
articles.description: Trump cancels Kansas and Iowa rallies, opting for telephone events across nearly 20 states over the weekend.

articles.headline: Jerusalem Daily: What’s next after Israel’s elections?
articles.title: Jerusalem Daily: What’s next after Israel’s elections?
articles.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and former military chief Gadi Eisenkot are both claiming victory in Israel’s election

articles.headline: Police in Jammu and Kashmir arrest ten terror financing associates
articles.title: Terror financing module: 10 associates of terrorists arrested in J&K
articles.summary: Police in Shopian district of Jammu and Kashmir have uncovered an intra-Union Territory terror financing module by arresting ten overground workers. Officials stated in Srinagar on October 30, 2026, that the arrests followed a focused investigation into suspicious online financial transactions and money trails linked to terrorists and their associates lodged in different jails.
articles.description: Shopian police traced online transactions across multiple payment platforms to uncover the network, which has links to terrorists lodged in different jails, officials said

articles.headline: Neoliberal policies drive youth protests and economic frustration across G7 nations
articles.title: How neoliberalism turned the world against its young
articles.summary: Young people are leading widespread demonstrations in countries like France, Spain, and Albania amid severe economic challenges such as high unemployment, inflation, and declining real wages. Experts argue that aggressive neoliberal reductions in public welfare spending and capitalist decisions to limit labor demand have caused youth unemployment rates to soar to nearly double the overall averages.
articles.description: The rise in youth unrest stems from failures of neoliberal capitalism, which has weakened public welfare and worsened unemployment; as falling wages undermine consumption and investment, young people face fewer jobs, rising education costs and an economic system that prioritises profits

articles.headline: Traders urge Congress to postpone November rally over business disruption fears
articles.title: CTI urges Congress to postpone November 1 rally, says ₹10,000-12,000 crore trade in Delhi markets at risk
articles.summary: The Chamber of Trade and Industry has urged Congress Parliamentary Party chairperson Sonia Gandhi to postpone a proposed November 1 rally at Ramlila Maidan until after Diwali to prevent disruption to business worth up to ₹12,000 crore across 20 major Delhi markets. The traders warned that the gathering of thousands of vehicles and people during peak festive season could cause severe traffic congestion.
articles.description: In a letter to Sonia Gandhi, the traders' body said the proposed rally, which is expected to draw 10 lakh people, could affect business worth ₹10,000-12,000 crore in wholesale and retail markets in central and old Delhi during the peak festive season

articles.headline: Iran warns of devastating economic fallout from any new Israeli attack
articles.title: Iran warns of 'devastating' economic fallout from any new Israeli attack
articles.summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi warned on October 28, 2026, that any renewed Israeli military action would trigger severe international market disruptions, particularly affecting gas suppliers and consumers. Amid ongoing regional conflicts and blockades affecting energy shipments, Washington reportedly advised Gulf Arab nations to prepare for a potential military campaign following the November 3 U.S. midterm elections.
articles.description: Under Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who has vowed to topple Iran's government, the two countries have directly fought a war for the first time in their history after decades of enmity

articles.headline: Benjamin Netanyahu leads in Israel election after partial vote count
articles.title: Netanyahu bloc leads Israel vote, falls short of majority
articles.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu held a narrow lead with 55 of 120 parliament seats after fifty percent of votes were counted on October 28, 2026. His rival Gadi Eisenkot secured forty-nine seats, while Arab parties claimed sixteen. Neither bloc reached a majority, prompting expectations of extended coalition negotiations or potential new elections following the general vote.
articles.description: With more than three quarters of the vote counted, Mr. Netanyahu’s right-wing bloc was slightly ahead but short of a majority

articles.headline: Rashid Khan becomes first men's player to take 200 T20I wickets
articles.title: Afghanistan’s Rashid Khan becomes first men’s player to claim 200 T20I wickets
articles.summary: Former Afghanistan cricket captain Rashid Khan became the first bowler to claim 200 wickets in men's Twenty20 internationals during a match against Zimbabwe in Sharjah. The 28-year-old leg-spinner reached the milestone in his 120th T20 international after trapping Tadiwanashe Marumani lbw in the ninth over. He currently sits 39 wickets clear of England player Adil Rashid at the top of the format all-time wicket-taking list.
articles.description: Rashid achieved the feat in ​his 120th ‌T20 international, with the 28-year-old boasting an average of 13.96 and an ‌economy rate of 6.13 ​in the format

articles.headline: Trump announces upcoming meeting between Putin and Zelensky
articles.title: Trump says Putin-Zelensky meeting to be set up 'very soon'
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump stated on October 28, 2026, that a face-to-face meeting between Russian President Vladimir Putin and Ukrainian counterpart Volodymyr Zelensky would be arranged very soon. The diplomatic push coincides with ongoing international efforts to end the multi-year conflict, though previous U.S.-led talks have stalled amid conflicting territorial objectives and persistent military casualties.
articles.description: "There'll be a meeting set up very soon and I think a lot of progress could be made," Mr. Trump told reporters

articles.headline: PNB assures genuine claims in Greater Noida fund misappropriation case
articles.title: PNB fund misappropriation case: Bank says genuine claims to be honoured, FIR registered in Gr Noida
articles.summary: Punjab National Bank assured customers on October 29, 2026, that all genuine claims will be honoured after settling three claims amounting to ₹43 lakh following alleged financial irregularities at its Greater Noida branch. An FIR has been registered under Section 316(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita after account holders alleged misappropriation exceeding ₹11.24 crore from savings and fixed deposit accounts.
articles.description: The bank said it was extending full cooperation to the authorities concerned and taking necessary steps to address the concerns of affected customers

articles.headline: Tamil Nadu Cabinet decides to form commission for social justice survey
articles.title: Tamil Nadu Cabinet decides to form commission headed by retd. HC judge to conduct Social Justice Survey
articles.summary: The Tamil Nadu Cabinet, headed by Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay, decided to constitute a multi-member commission led by a retired High Court judge to conduct a Social Justice Survey next year. Announced on October 29, 2026, in Chennai, the survey will take place following the census. The Cabinet also approved eight industrial proposals and discussed handling poramboke land issues.
articles.description: The decision was taken at the Cabinet meeting chaired CM Vijay at the Secretariat in Chennai on Thursday

articles.headline: Directorate of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption searches former minister K.N. Nehru's residence
articles.title: DVAC searches premises linked to ex-Minister K.N. Nehru
articles.summary: Anti-corruption officials in Tamil Nadu searched the Tiruchi residence of former minister K.N. Nehru on Thursday as part of an investigation into an alleged cash-for-jobs scam. The Directorate of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption launched operations across 25 locations following a Madras High Court clearance. DMK chief M.K. Stalin condemned the raids as politically motivated vendetta tactics ahead of upcoming by-elections.
articles.description: The search at Mr. Nehru’s residence, carried out by a team headed by a Deputy Superintendent of Police, began around 7 a.m.

articles.headline: Anti-corruption agency searches properties linked to former DMK legislator in Vellore
articles.title: DVAC searches places linked to former DMK MLA in Vellore
articles.summary: State investigators searched properties belonging to A.P. Nandakumar on October 29, 2026. According to anti-corruption officials, the operation forms part of a broader inquiry into a multi-crore cash-for-jobs scandal. The politician denied any wrongdoing and stated that nothing was seized from his residence.
articles.description: The searches are part of the ongoing probe at 25 locations across Tamil Nadu linked to former Minister and DMK leader K.N. Nehru in connection with an alleged ₹634-crore cash-for-jobs scam

articles.headline: Supreme Court questions government over fuel supply for 100 percent ethanol vehicles
articles.title: SC questions Government: If permission given for 100% ethanol-run vehicles, how will supply be made
articles.summary: The Supreme Court of India questioned the federal administration on October 29, 2026, regarding supply logistics for vehicles running entirely on pure ethanol. Justices M.M. Sundresh and Prasanna B. Varale raised the query during hearings on ethanol allocation for the 2025-26 period, while Attorney General R. Venkataramani stated that such a shift would necessitate extensive manufacturing re-arrangements across the country.
articles.description: The Bench sought answers from the Government on how the supply for 100% ethanol will be made and also stressed on empowering farmers and looking at the issue from an environmental point of view

articles.headline: NIMHANS study links nutritional deficiencies and alcohol intake to venous stroke in Karnataka
articles.title: Nutritional deficiencies, alcohol intake linked to venous stroke in Karnataka: NIMHANS study
articles.summary: Researchers at the National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences published a study on October 29, 2026, indicating that nutritional deficiencies and alcohol consumption contribute significantly to cerebral venous thrombosis prevalence in Karnataka. This specific subtype of stroke involves blood clots forming in the cerebral veins and venous sinuses that drain blood from the brain.
articles.description: The researchers found that CVT patients were more likely to have diets deficient in protein and folate. Elevated homocysteine levels, anaemia and alcohol consumption were also common among those diagnosed with the condition

articles.headline: Congress prepares for Delhi rally while reassessing electoral strategy against government
articles.title: Beyond ‘vote chori’, Congress needs a broader strategy to take on Modi government
articles.summary: The Congress party is organizing a demonstration at Ramlila Maidan while members debate balancing the campaign against electronic voting issues with everyday concerns like inflation. Leaders discussed focusing on public grievances alongside ongoing protests concerning the Election Commission, pointing to economic pressures during the festive season and recent local election outcomes.
articles.description: Congress and the wider Opposition bloc may need to recalibrate their strategy on the alleged ‘vote chori’ campaign, which has overshadowed issues that affect voters’ everyday lives

articles.headline: Boston Consulting Group reports technology services firms face talent decisions in AI expansion
articles.title: Tech services firms face a talent decision, not a shortage, in $100-200 billion AI race, says Boston Consulting Group
articles.summary: Technology services companies possess the necessary personnel to handle artificial intelligence growth through internal upskilling rather than facing severe skill shortages, according to a Boston Consulting Group report released on October 29, 2026. Managing Director Sreyssha George stated that client shifts toward outcome-based compensation require updated role architectures to leverage existing payroll professionals efficiently.
articles.description: BCG analysis has identified 40 distinct Applied AI roles, each linked to an existing technology role. A data scientist or full-stack developer can grow into a forward-deployed engineer, a DevOps engineer into an AI Ops engineer, and a data engineer into a semantic engineer

articles.headline: One Planet Partners launches maiden private equity fund to deploy over three thousand crore rupees
articles.title: VC firm One Planet Partners to deploy over ₹3,000 crore in high-growth business in India
articles.summary: India-focused private equity firm One Planet Partners announced a strategic partnership with Japan's Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank and launched its maiden fund on October 29, 2026, targeting investments exceeding three thousand crore rupees. The fund will provide scale-up capital for mid-market enterprises in energy, mobility, and manufacturing, having already backed Bengaluru-based electric mobility company Yulu.
articles.description: The fund would focus on high-growth mid-market businesses across energy, mobility and manufacturing, with scale-up capital of ₹ 100–500 crore for enterprises with revenue between ₹200 and 2,000 crore, says One Planet Partners, an India-focused private equity firm

articles.headline: Countdown progressing for ISRO navigation satellite launch
articles.title: Countdown progressing for ISRO’s crucial GSLV-F18 launch carrying navigation satellite NVS-03
articles.summary: The Indian Space Research Organisation commenced the 24-hour countdown on October 29, 2026, for the GSLV-F18 rocket launch carrying the NVS-03 satellite from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre. Liftoff is scheduled at 11:51 p.m. on October 30, 2026, aiming to deploy the 2,232 kg spacecraft into a Geosynchronous Transfer Orbit. This flight features open pyro valves to prevent past connector failures.
articles.description: The Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle carrying on board the GSLV-F18 rocket is scheduled to lift off at 11.51 p.m. on Friday (October 30, 2026) from the second launch pad at the Satish Dhawan Space Centre

articles.headline: Legal provisions regarding driving offences committed by underage individuals
articles.title: What does the law say about offences committed by underage drivers? | Explained
articles.summary: The provided text is partial and does not constitute a full news article.
articles.description: Section 4 of the the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 specifies that no person under the age of eighteen years shall drive a motor vehicle in any public place. However, a person can drive a motorcycle without gears and with an engine capacity not exceeding 50cc after attaining 16 years.

articles.headline: New York state police to investigate all Cornell sex complaints
articles.title: New York police will now investigate Cornell sex complaints, governor says
articles.summary: New York Governor Kathy Hochul announced that state police will investigate all future sexual offence complaints at Cornell University following fallout from a 2024 gang rape allegation involving a student known as Jane Doe. The agreement shifts jurisdiction from university police to state police, amid a faculty no-confidence vote against administration and President Michael Kotlikoff.
articles.description: The change was announced amid backlash over the school's handling of gang rape allegations involving a fraternity on campus.

articles.headline: Why are Detroit gas stations selling discounted fuel in Trump’s name?
articles.title: Why are Detroit gas stations selling discounted fuel in Trump’s name?
articles.description: Gas stations promoted by President Trump are selling discounted fuel in Detroit as Americans grapple with rising prices.

articles.headline: BJP leader Sanjay Jaiswal criticises Congress over election defeats
articles.title: Congress’s poor performance in ballot-based elections exposes contradictions in its claims: Sanjay Jaiswal
articles.summary: Former Bihar Bharatiya Janata Party President Sanjay Jaiswal alleged on October 28, 2026, that opposition electoral defeats expose contradictions in Congress claims while undermining constitutional institutions. Speaking in Patna, Jaiswal defended the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls and criticized the opposition for raising doubts about Electronic Voting Machines and the Election Commission of India.
articles.description: Attempts were being made to spread misinformation about the Special Intensive Revision (SIR), Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs), and the electoral process to undermine public confidence in democracy, says Mr. Jaiswal

articles.headline: Flash floods kill five people across northern and eastern Syria
articles.title: Flash floods kill five in Syria
articles.summary: Heavy rains triggered deadly flash floods across northern and eastern Syrian provinces, killing at least five people, including four children who drowned in Raqqa and Deir Az Zor governorates. The Ministry of Emergency and Disaster Management reported five missing individuals, infrastructure damage including the collapse of al-Salmani Bridge, and the evacuation of 375 families from rural camps.
articles.description: Four children drowned while a man died after his car was caught in floodwaters.

articles.headline: Three people die following midair collision between two helicopters in Oregon
articles.title: Three dead after two helicopters collide midair near Oregon airport
articles.summary: Two aircraft crashed near McMinnville Municipal Airport on Thursday afternoon, resulting in three fatalities. Federal authorities and safety investigators responded to the site following the incident involving a flight training school. Victims included a Texas flight instructor, a British student pilot, and a local resident.
articles.description: The collision involving a Robinson R22 and an Airbus helicopter occurred on Thursday afternoon, with both aircraft crashing in a field adjacent to a highway.

articles.headline: Uttar Pradesh MLC election results provide lessons for BJP
articles.title: Lessons for the BJP from Uttar Pradesh MLC election
articles.summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party secured six out of eleven contested seats in the legislative council elections across Graduates and Teachers constituencies. Published on October 29, 2026, the outcomes indicate potential challenges for the ruling party ahead of the upcoming Assembly election as leadership considers significant changes among sitting members of the legislative assembly.
articles.description: The first big takeaway for the BJP is that the results of the MLC election demonstrate the 2024 Lok Sabha results may not be a fluke, when the SP, with 37 seats, brought down the BJP’s handsome tallies of 71 seats in 2014 and 62 seats in 2019 to 33 seats in 2024

articles.headline: Husband of one of Modi’s closest advisors questions election integrity
articles.title: Husband of one of Modi’s closest advisors questions election integrity
articles.description: The husband of India’s finance minister in the Modi government has joined mass protests against voter-list revision.

articles.headline: Fujimori tours El Salvador mega-prison with hopes to build one in Peru
articles.title: Fujimori tours El Salvador mega-prison with hopes to build one in Peru
articles.description: Peru’s President Keiko Fujimori has inspected El Salvador’s mega-prison as she mulls a proposal to build one in Peru.

articles.headline: Cognizant lowers Project Leap cost estimate as third-quarter revenue rises
articles.title: Cognizant cuts Project Leap cost estimate to $180–250 million; headcount rises
articles.summary: Cognizant Technology Solutions lowered its estimated costs for its restructuring programme, Project Leap, to between $180 million and $250 million, according to its third-quarter earnings released on October 29, 2026. The company reported third-quarter revenue of $5.664 billion and net income of $627 million, while total headcount rose to 359,900 as Chief Executive Ravi Kumar S. highlighted increased artificial intelligence integration.
articles.description: IT services firm reports 10,100 more employees year-on-year; quarterly employee separation costs stood at $46 million; CEO says over 50% of its code is AI-assisted

articles.headline: Karnataka chief minister warns private companies against employment discrimination towards locals
articles.title: Jobs for locals: How feasible is the idea?
articles.summary: Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar cautioned private institutions against sidelining local workers following public complaints on social media. Writing on X on October 25, the official stated that the administration would penalise companies that disregard employment opportunities for Kannadigas, responding directly to citizens who alleged discrimination and sought government intervention.
articles.description: The old debate on reservation in jobs for locals is resurfacing at a time when employment in the IT sector and elsewhere have become hard to find and the threat of Artificial Intelligence taking away jobs looms large. Sharath S. Srivatsa looks at multiple angles of the debate...

articles.headline: Watch: Why Australia's mushroom murderer may now die in prison
articles.title: Watch: Why Australia's mushroom murderer may now die in prison
articles.description: Judges agreed with the prosecution’s appeal that Erin Patterson’s initial non-parole period of 33 years was insufficient.

articles.headline: Australian appeal court rejects murder conviction challenge and blocks parole eligibility
articles.title: Mushroom murderer fails to overturn convictions in Australian court challenge
articles.summary: Victoria's Court of Appeal dismissed a legal challenge from Erin Patterson on Friday. Judges ruled that her life sentence for poisoning relatives with toxic mushrooms must exclude any possibility of future release due to extreme criminality. The panel rejected all seven defense arguments regarding trial errors.
articles.description: Erin Patterson argued her trial was unfair due to seven grounds but three appeal judges dismissed them all.

articles.headline: US Department of Justice files revised lawsuit seeking to decertify Alaska election results
articles.title: Trump administration renews bid to block Alaska election results
articles.summary: The United States Department of Justice filed an amended lawsuit aiming to block certification of a crucial Senate race in Alaska if Republican incumbent Dan S Sullivan loses. Prosecutors alleged Democratic challenger Mary Peltola orchestrated a sham campaign by recruiting a spoiler candidate to confuse voters. Critics questioned federal jurisdiction over state election administration.
articles.description: The updated lawsuit cites a new report that Democratic operatives recruited a competitor to confuse voters.

articles.headline: Ethiopia border clashes leave families hungry and homeless in Kenya
articles.title: Ethiopia border clashes leave families hungry and homeless in Kenya
articles.description: Fighting over disputed land and water in Ethiopia’s Moyale border region has driven thousands of people into Kenya.

articles.headline: Italian military helicopter crash during training in Bosnia kills four people
articles.title: EU force helicopter crash kills four in Bosnia
articles.summary: An Italian military helicopter conducting routine training crashed in the Brcko region of Bosnia, killing four nationals and injuring eleven others. The European Union Force in Bosnia stated that the victims included two soldiers and two Red Cross volunteers. A local hospital treated twelve survivors while investigations into the incident continued.
articles.description: EUFOR confirms CH-47 Chinook helicopter crash in Bosnia, with four Italian nationals confirmed dead.

articles.headline: Manisha Bhanwala reaches World Wrestling Championships final in Astana
articles.title: Manisha Bhanwala becomes third Indian woman to reach World Wrestling Championships Final
articles.summary: Wrestler Manisha Bhanwala advanced to the 59kg final at the World Wrestling Championships in Astana on Thursday, October 29, 2026, by defeating Laurence Beauregard, Bolortuya Khurelkhuu, and Altyn Shagayeva. She became the third Indian woman to reach the tournament final, where she will face Abigail Elizabeth Nette. Meanwhile, teammates Neelam Sirohi and Kajal Dhochak secured silver medals for the country in their respective weight divisions.
articles.description: Manisha shocked World championships bronze medallist Laurence Beauregard by pinning the Canadian in the second period

articles.headline: Trump cancels midterm rally appearances in Iowa and Kansas for tele-rallies
articles.title: Trump cancels Iowa, Kansas midterm events, opts for ‘tele-rallies’
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump cancelled upcoming midterm rally appearances in Iowa and Kansas, opting instead for virtual tele-rallies across nearly twenty states. The Republican National Committee confirmed the schedule change on Thursday ahead of the November 3, 2026 elections, which will determine control of Congress. Trump defended his travel schedule and health to reporters after polls showed tight races in traditionally safe Republican strongholds.
articles.description: The Republican National Committee has announced broadcasts in nearly 20 states after Trump nixes final rallies.

articles.headline: Armenian parliament turns into a boxing ring, third time in a month
articles.title: Armenian parliament turns into a boxing ring, third time in a month
articles.description: Armenia’s parliament descended into fisticuffs after a ruling-party MP mocked the opposition leader’s family.

articles.headline: What does bourbon have to do with the US midterms?
articles.title: What does bourbon have to do with the US midterms?
articles.description: The US-Canada trade war is hurting Kentucky’s bourbon industry, which generates billions of dollars annually.

articles.headline: Indian start-ups emerge to support ageing population amid changing family structures
articles.title: Indians turn to start-ups to care for ageing parents as young become more mobile
articles.summary: India is experiencing a significant demographic shift as the proportion of older citizens grows, driven by shrinking joint families and the migration of younger relatives. Entrepreneurs are launching specialized enterprises to provide senior housing, home care, and technology-enabled monitoring services. Government data values this expanding market at seven billion dollars. However, industry experts warn that the sector faces serious challenges regarding workforce training, security vetting, and service affordability.
articles.description: Changing family structures in India are driving demand for start-ups offering services for eldercare.

articles.headline: France deploys seventy thousand police officers ahead of planned Halloween demonstrations
articles.title: France braces for ‘very high risk’ of disorder at Halloween protests
articles.summary: Interior Minister Laurent Nunez announced the deployment of seventy thousand security personnel across France to address potential violence during demonstrations coinciding with October 31. Protests regarding living expenses have previously resulted in widespread looting, arrests, and clashes involving far-right and left-wing factions. Authorities intend to prohibit rallies within major city centres and target individuals concealing their identities.
articles.description: Authorities vow firm action against violence as yellow vest and student movements announce widespread demonstrations.

articles.headline: US Department of Homeland Security attempts to remove ICE employee database
articles.title: Trump administration attempts to take down leak of ICE personnel data
articles.summary: The United States Department of Homeland Security asked Icelandic web hosting company FlokiNET to remove a website publishing personal information about forty thousand agency employees. The leaked dataset was shared online after a hacker group claimed responsibility. Although the initial domain was suspended, the information migrated elsewhere as the Trump administration pursued aggressive action against online platforms containing federal agent details.
articles.description: An Icelandic web company, FlokiNET, has defended the data's publication as satisfying a 'legitimate' public interest.

articles.headline: Alaska governor orders investigation into Democratic campaign links to second candidate
articles.title: Alaska governor orders probe into Democratic campaign's alleged links to same-name candidate
articles.summary: The Republican governor of Alaska, Mike Dunleavy, directed the Department of Public Safety to investigate whether an alleged scheme by Democratic candidate Mary Peltola's team to recruit a spoiler candidate violated state laws. The directive follows media reports alleging coordination to place a second Dan Sullivan on the Senate ballot. Peltola's campaign and the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee have denied involvement in the matter.
articles.description: The Republican governor was responding to allegations in the New York Times that Democrats recruited a spoiler candidate, Dan Sullivan.

articles.headline: Palestinians face growing bans from Al-Aqsa Mosque amid Israeli restrictions
articles.title: Palestinians face growing bans from Al-Aqsa as Israel tightens control
articles.summary: Palestinian religious figures and worshippers face escalating exclusion orders barring them from the Al-Aqsa Mosque in East Jerusalem. Sheikh Ekrima Sabri received an extension banning him from the site until April 2027 following previous detentions. Human rights monitors reported that Israeli authorities issued over one thousand exclusion orders since the beginning of 2026 while Jewish religious activists increasingly accessed the compound.
articles.description: As Israel renews a ban on Al-Aqsa imam, Islamic Waqf officials warn of shrinking authority at Muslim holy site.

articles.headline: Israel bans travel for Brad Lander after detention in occupied West Bank
articles.title: Israel bans travel for Brad Lander after detention in occupied West Bank
articles.description: Israel has revoked travel authorisation for US Democratic congressional candidate Brad Lander after he was detained.

articles.headline: Madras High Court questions excise commissioner on hotel bar licences
articles.title: Any plan to restrict sale of liquor in hotel bars and clubs located close to educational institutions? Madras High Court asks Commissioner of Prohibition and Excise
articles.summary: The Madras High Court directed the Commissioner of Prohibition and Excise to clarify whether rules exist for licensing hotel bars near educational institutions. Justice N. Ramesh issued the order during an anticipatory bail hearing for a nineteen-year-old student involved in a drunken brawl at a bar near a Chennai college. The court ordered interim protection from arrest for the petitioner.
articles.description: Justice N. Ramesh poses the question after expressing shock over a 19-year-old college student having consumed liquor at a bar attached to a hotel reportedly run by the college management

articles.headline: Vladimir Putin hosts African leaders in Moscow to strengthen diplomatic ties
articles.title: Does Russia offer African countries an equal partnership?
articles.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin hosted African leaders at the third Russia-Africa Summit in Moscow, stating that Russian companies operate on the continent as equal partners. Putin accused Western nations of exploiting African resources, while Moscow sought support from the Global South regarding its war in Ukraine. Analysts discussed the mutual benefits of the gathering amid growing trade, economic ties, and security assistance.
articles.description: President Vladimir Putin hosts African leaders at a summit in Moscow.

articles.headline: Kherson experiences temporary ceasefire allowing residents rare moments of quiet
